# FLX-5005: statistic refused: sample outside the declared bounds

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

A fidelity comparison fails closed rather than reporting agreement over a sample it cannot stand behind: an empty sample, a record count outside the declared records range, a group below records.min, a variance below the declared floor, or bin counts that do not account for every record.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5005
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
